Vortex 600W blender

The Vortex 600W blender costs ₹1,299 and comes with a 1.5 litre jar, a pulse setting and a two year warranty on the motor. The blades are stainless steel and the jar is dishwasher safe on the top rack.

The motor is rated for continuous operation of up to three minutes before it needs a rest, which is enough for most smoothie and chutney work in a domestic kitchen. The lid seals with a silicone gasket that can be removed for cleaning, and the base has rubber feet so it does not walk across the counter at higher speeds. Spare jars are available separately.
